L04.title: How do people explain where the world comes from?

englishVideo.title: The Big Bang Explained

L04.reason: No Malaysian-made, Malay-language video on how the universe began was found that was verifiably by a Malaysian creator or institution. The one Malay-language Big Bang video that turned up (GEOGERHANA, BlpQoPYooiw) uses the Indonesian word 'Ledakan' and was rejected as probably Indonesian. Results for 'origin of the world' in Malay were mostly religious sermons, which the brief rules out.
L04.proposal: Keep the English video (it is a science account, introduced as one kind of account) with the written version in Malay, or ask a Malaysian science educator (for example Planetarium Negara) to make a 2-minute one. Lesson 4 also needs a local educator's preview whatever video is used.

L22.reason: Searches for Malaysian, Malay-language videos on saving, spending and budgeting that suit 10-17 year olds found only adult-salary tips (Afham Yusof), parent-facing advice (Dr Adam Zubir), Indonesian videos and national-budget news. L22.proposal: A person should browse the BNM Kids channel (youtube.com/c/BNMKids) and AKPK Official (youtube.com/akpkofficial) for a short saving or budgeting video. Until then keep the English video (Teaching Without Frills) with the Malay written version, or make one.
